as_told.title: Lazar replaced someone killed while cutting into the craft with a blowtorch

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in the Nevada desert in the late 1980s, tells podcast host Jesse Michels what he says he was told about the man who had his job before him. According to Lazar, that man was killed when a team took one of the craft's power reactors to the Nevada Test Site, the government's nuclear testing ground, and cut into it while it was running under load, and it exploded. If true, it would show how dangerous and poorly understood that technology was to the people handling it.
